title: Add ensemble-score-aggregator and CI regression hook for composite eval metrics
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: teams running multi-metric evals need a single, auditable signal for CI gating that reflects weighted regressions across prompt sets and metric families. This PR introduces an "ensemble score" aggregator that computes a weighted composite from a configurable set of metrics (e.g. BLEU, ROUGE-L, exact-match, embedding-sim) and a CI hook that fails builds when the ensemble score or any high-priority submetric regresses past configured thresholds. What changed: added aggregator implementation, config schema, CI integration, unit + integration tests, docs and migration notes. Checklist: [x] implementation, [x] schema & defaults, [x] unit tests, [x] integration test against sample prompt-sets, [x] CI job wired to GitHub Actions, [x] docs and example config in docs/evals. Related: Linear ENG-2141, ENG-2210; references: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2141/ensemble-eval-signal and design doc link (internal).

release_notes: Introduces ensemble scoring for multi-metric evaluations and a CI hook that gates on composite/regression thresholds. Provides config schema and docs; may require downstream eval configs to opt in.
notes_for_ops: Ops should add ensemble thresholds to protected repos if they want CI gating; default behavior is opt-in. CI job eval-regression.yml added to standard workflow; ensure runners have python3.11 and eval-harness dependencies installed.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: code paths for existing single-metric evals unchanged. New aggregator has unit coverage and integration tests. Potential for false positives if weights misconfigured; mitigated by opt-in default and clear docs.
